newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Anixter to open training centres in Asia.
newsitem.headline: Anixter to open training centres in Asia.

text.p: U.S. company Anixter International Inc said on Monday it is setting up centres in Southeast Asia to offer information technology (IT) training.
Daphne Tham, Anixer's director of education services for the Asia Pacific region, told Reuters the company hoped to set up five or six centres in about two years' time.
The first centre was set up in Malaysia in March this year.
Anixter signed a memorandum of understanding on Monday with the Singapore section the Institute if Electrical and Electronics Engineers (IEEE) to endorse its courses.
The IEEE promotes standardization and consults the American National Standards Institute on matters related to electric and electronic development.
Tham said education services were a new area of business for Anixter, a computer network integration company.
"We are targetting IT professionals and the focus will be on data communications, networking and telecommunications," she said.
After Southeast Asia, Anixter will expand its education services to Greater China, she said.
Anixter has made an initial investment of US$700,000 on equipment and aimed to break even in the first year, she said.
